'''Aris FC''' ({{langx|el|ΠΑΕ Άρης}}) {{IPA|el|'aris|}}, commonly known as '''Aris Thessaloniki'''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/nationalassociations/teams/52949--aris/|title=Aris Thessaloniki FC | National Associations|website=[[UEFA]]|access-date=6 August 2023}}</ref> or simply '''Aris''', is a Greek professional [[Association football|football]] club from the city of [[Thessaloniki]], [[Macedonia (Greece)|Macedonia]], Greece. The team competes in the top-tier [[Super League Greece]] and their home ground is the [[Kleanthis Vikelidis Stadium]].

Founded in 1914, the club was a founding member of the [[Union of Football Clubs of Macedonia (Thessaloniki)|Macedonian Football Clubs Association]], as well as the [[Hellenic Football Federation]]. The colours of the club are golden/yellow, a dominant colour in the culture of [[Macedonia (ancient kingdom)|Macedonia]] and reminiscent of the Byzantine heritage of Thessaloniki, and black. It is named after [[Ares]], the ancient [[Twelve Olympians|Olympian]] "God of War," associated also with courage and masculinity, whose image is portrayed on the club's logo as depicted in the [[Ludovisi Ares]] sculpture. It is considered as one of the biggest teams in Greece and is part of the [[Sport club|multi-sports]] club [[Aris Thessaloniki]].

Aris was also one of the strongest and most popular teams in Greece during the [[interwar period]]. They have won the [[List of Greek football champions|Greek championship]] three times ([[1927–28 Panhellenic Championship|1928]], [[1931–32 Panhellenic Championship|1932]], [[1945–46 Panhellenic Championship|1946]]), the [[Greek Cup]] once ([[Greek Cup 1969–70|1970]]), and they had an undefeated home record in European competitions for 28 matches from 1968 to 2020, when they lost to [[FC Kolos Kovalivka|Kolos Kovalivka]] but without crowd due to COVID. Other than that Aris has never lost playing at home in European competitions.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/EuropaLeague/arhs-prwth-entos-edras-eyrwpaikh-htta-meta-apo-28-mats-kai-52-xronia.5753501.html|title=Πρώτη εντός έδρας ευρωπαϊκή ήττα μετά από 28 ματς και 52 χρόνια|author=Ilias Kallonas|date=17 September 2020|language=el|work=sport24.gr}}</ref>"}}
